scientific_integrity: Exact proof with explicit parity-completion counts, sector eigenvalues and 7,799 exact finite test assertions; finite tests are not substituted for proof.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the degree-zero and degree-one Walsh sampling Gram on even derangements for n>=4, not higher-degree or odd-conditioned spectra. Historical priority is provisional pending independent review.
title: Parity-conditioned Walsh sampling on even derangements: exact eigenvalues and a nine-label phase reversal
